// Classifier fixture, vitest: TITLE-CONTRADICTION, one positive per reason, and the negative of
// each. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("title contradiction", () => {
  it("returns undefined for unknown routes", async () => {
    await middleware(request);
    expect(request.auditLog).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("returns undefined for unknown ids", async () => {
    expect(await find("x")).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("throws on an invalid token", async () => {
    const result = await verify("bad");
    expect(result).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("throws on an expired token", async () => {
    await expect(verify("old")).rejects.toThrow(TokenExpired);
  });

  it("responds with 404 for a missing post", async () => {
    const response = await app.inject({ url: "/posts/x" });
    expect(response.json().error).toBe("NOT_FOUND");
  });

  it("responds with 404 for a missing draft", async () => {
    const response = await app.inject({ url: "/drafts/x" });
    expect(response.statusCode).toBe(404);
  });

  it("does not start twice", () => {
    relay.start();
    relay.start();
    expect(relay.running).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("does not start a stopped relay", () => {
    relay.stop();
    expect(relay.running).toBe(false);
  });

  it("rejects an empty name", () => {
    const result = validate("");
    expect(result).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("rejects a long name", () => {
    const result = validate("x".repeat(300));
    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("falls back when the provider throws", async () => {
    provider.fail();
    expect(await describePost()).toBe("plain");
  });
});
